name: golangci-action-bump
summary: One line in a CI workflow moves golangci-lint-action from v6 to v7. The pinned linter version beside it does not change.
why_this_fixture_exists: The 29 percent of changes that deserve no comment is the harder half of the quality bar and the one homegrown reviewers miss. A reviewer that always finds something is a generator, and the first invented problem on a clean change is the last time anyone reads its output.

quiet.about: speculating about the major version bump
quiet.note: There is nothing here to review. Asking whether v7 has breaking changes, or suggesting the version be pinned to a SHA, is padding.
